hazards.control: Stay clear under the horsehead and beside the bridle; a parted rod string drops the load.

name: Bridle and carrier bar
function: The pair of wire ropes from the horsehead to the carrier bar that hangs the polished rod clamp.

tabs.overview: Follows the horsehead arc so the rod stays vertical.
tabs.engineering: Rated above the peak polished rod load.
tabs.safety: Never under the carrier bar while the unit runs.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
